title: FY26-Q2 on-prem & VPC: enterprise roadmap alignment and pilot sequencing
creator: Aisha Tremblay
description:
Summary:
This ticket captures the product management plan to align FY26 Q2 roadmap work for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features. The goal is to produce a sequenced set of deliverables and pilot timelines that satisfy top enterprise requirements (SLA, KMS/HSM integration, audited upgrades, installer resilience) while keeping Hosted/Dedicated customers unaffected.

Goals / Success metrics:
- Produce a finalized quarter roadmap and milestone calendar by 2026-03-20.
- Kick-off 2 enterprise pilots (one VPC, one air-gapped on-prem) by 2026-04-15.
- Reduce private deploy time-to-first-success by 30% (measured on internal install runbook tests).
- Shipping key enterprise controls: RBAC for on-prem console, KMS integration, upgrade rollback paths.

Scope / In-scope features:
- KMS/HSM: bring-your-own-key workflow and CI for key rotation testing.
- Secure installer: idempotent installer with clearer healthchecks and offline package support.
- RBAC + Audit logs: console role bindings and write-once audit stream to customer SIEM.
- Upgrade orchestration: safe roll-forward/rollback with state snapshots and migration verification.
- Pilot program design: selection criteria, success criteria, and support SLOs.

Out-of-scope for Q2:
- Major runtime kernel changes (deferred to runtime-1.20).
- Deep optimization for multi-tenant Dedicated pools (handled in Dedicated roadmap).

Decisions to make:
1) Pilot sequencing: do we run VPC pilot first (faster network), or on-prem air-gapped pilot first (higher compliance value)?
2) KMS integration: which KMS vendors to certify in Q2 (AWS KMS + HashiCorp Vault recommended)?
3) Support model: will pilots use a white-glove professional services bundle or scaled success engagement?

Stakeholders:
- Product: Aisha (owner), Miguel (lead PM)
- Eng: Natasha (private runtime), Omar (installer), Eng-ops team
- Security & Compliance: Priya
- Solutions / Customer Success: Grace
- Sales / AE: Jonathan (pilot customers)

Key artifacts:
- Roadmap draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRIVATE/OnPrem+FY26Q2+Draft
- Pilot criteria doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPilotDocs
- Installer PR (tech spike): https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-installer/pull/284
- Console RBAC design: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRIVATE/Console+RBAC+Design

Risks / Mitigations:
- Risk: Installer regressions cause pilot delays. Mitigation: add dedicated runbook tests and schedule a rollback-only hotfix window in week 3.
- Risk: KMS vendor API differences increase integration time. Mitigation: prioritize AWS KMS for pilot and prototype Vault adapter as a second track.
- Risk: Engineering capacity conflict with Dedicated autoscaling work. Mitigation: align with Eng leads and mark non-blocking features as stretch goals.

Next steps / Action items:
- [Aisha] Finalize roadmap milestones and share with Eng leads by 2026-03-20.
- [Miguel] Confirm pilot customer shortlist and get NDAs signed by 2026-03-26.
- [Omar] Deliver installer spike PR and test matrix by 2026-03-30.
- [Priya] Start security sign-off checklist and identify external audit requirements by 2026-04-05.
